caption:
Stuck at a wall with no way through? The same ruin can become a door. (Amos 4:3 devotional)

The same ruin is a door of destruction or of rescue — depending on whose hand you take. You don't have to break through on your own.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 The wall in front of me — am I trying to break through it all on my own?
